schema.name: multilingual-intent
schema.description: Map what a user says to a phone or home assistant, in any supported language, to one intent.
schema.state: One user utterance to a voice or chat assistant, in any language.

intent.instructions: What is the user asking the assistant to do?

criteria.alarm_set: Set an alarm or a wake-up call.
criteria.calendar_set: Add an event or meeting to the calendar.
criteria.calendar_query: Ask what is in the calendar.
criteria.datetime_query: Ask the current time or date, or the time somewhere else.
criteria.weather_query: Ask about the weather or the forecast.
criteria.play_music: Play a song, artist, album or genre.
criteria.lights_on: Turn lights on or make them brighter.
criteria.lights_off: Turn lights off or dim them.
criteria.lists_add: Add an item to a list, such as a shopping list.
criteria.news_query: Ask for the news or headlines.
criteria.takeaway_order: Order food for delivery or collection.
criteria.transport_query: Ask about trains, buses, traffic or directions.
criteria.general_question: A general knowledge question or small talk.

yaml:
# Tez schema (format: docs/API.md, "Schema files"). Gallery example with MASSIVE-style assistant intents.
# 20 options, the same size as the measured MASSIVE protocol; labels and instructions stay in English for every language.
name: multilingual-intent
description: Map what a user says to a phone or home assistant, in any supported language, to one intent.
state: "One user utterance to a voice or chat assistant, in any language."
questions:
  intent:
    type: choice
    instructions: What is the user asking the assistant to do?
    criteria:
      alarm_set: Set an alarm or a wake-up call.
      alarm_query: Ask which alarms are set.
      alarm_remove: Delete or cancel an alarm.
      calendar_set: Add an event or meeting to the calendar.
      calendar_query: Ask what is in the calendar.
      datetime_query: Ask the current time or date, or the time somewhere else.
      weather_query: Ask about the weather or the forecast.
      play_music: Play a song, artist, album or genre.
      play_radio: Play a radio station.
      play_podcasts: Play or resume a podcast.
      audio_volume_up: Make the sound louder.
      audio_volume_down: Make the sound quieter.
      lights_on: Turn lights on or make them brighter.
      lights_off: Turn lights off or dim them.
      lists_add: Add an item to a list, such as a shopping list.
      email_send: Write or send an email.
      news_query: Ask for the news or headlines.
      takeaway_order: Order food for delivery or collection.
      transport_query: Ask about trains, buses, traffic or directions.
      general_question: A general knowledge question or small talk.
